description.zh: 关联已有模型算子实例id，仅当ApplicationType为polarclaw时生效
description.en: The ID of an existing model operator instance to associate. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

description.zh:
应用类型，取值范围为

- supabase: 若创建托管 Supabase 应用，请传入此值
- raycluster: 若创建托管 Ray Cluster 应用，请传入此值
- polarclaw: 若创建托管 PolarClaw 应用，请传入此值
description.en:
The type of the application. Valid values:

- supabase: Creates a managed Supabase application.

- raycluster: Creates a managed Ray Cluster application.

- polarclaw: Creates a managed PolarClaw application.

description.zh:
CPU 架构，取值范围

- x86
description.en:
The CPU architecture. Valid value:

- x86
The authentication service provider.
The configuration of the authentication provider.

description.zh: 是否自动创建并绑定弹性公网IP
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically create and bind an Elastic IP Address (EIP).

description.zh:
是否自动创建冷存版Polarlakebase，取值：
* false（默认）：不自动创建。
* true：自动创建。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically create a PolarFS cold storage instance. Valid values:

- false (default): Does not automatically create the instance.

- true: Automatically creates the instance.
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal.

description.zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
* true（默认）：使用优惠券。
* false：不使用优惠券。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically use a coupon. Valid values:

- true (default): Uses a coupon.

- false: Does not use a coupon.

description.zh: 用户自定义的应用子组件列表
description.en: A list of custom child components for the application.
The specifications of the child component.

description.zh:
同一规格应用子组件的最大数量，默认等于ComponentReplica

- 仅 raycluster 支持该参数
description.en:
The maximum number of child components with the same specifications. The default value is the value of ComponentReplica.

- This parameter is supported only for raycluster.

description.zh: 应用子组件的副本数量，默认为1
description.en: The number of replicas for the child component. The default value is 1.

description.zh:
应用子组件的类型

对于 supabase，取值范围为

- gateway
- backend

对于 raycluster，取值范围为

- head
- worker
- gpuworker
description.en:
The type of the child component.

For supabase, valid values are:

- gateway

- backend

For raycluster, valid values are:

- head

- worker

- gpuworker
The maximum number of component replicas for scaling.
The minimum number of component replicas for scaling.

description.zh: 应用子组件的安全组列表，使用英文逗号分隔
description.en: The security groups for the child component. Separate multiple security group IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 应用子组件白名单IP地址组的名称，默认为default
description.en: The name of the IP address whitelist group for the child component. The default value is default.

description.zh: 应用子组件的白名单IP地址，英文逗号分隔
description.en: The IP address whitelist for the child component. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

description.zh: 应用子组件的白名单IP的类型，默认为 ipv4
description.en: The type of the IP address in the whitelist for the child component. The default value is ipv4.
The ID of the PolarDB instance that the application depends on.
The description of the application.

description.zh: 默认为`false`，设置为`true`后将只进行参数和资源校验，不实际创建资源。
description.en: The default value is `false`. If you set this parameter to `true`, the system only checks the parameters and resources without creating the actual resources.

description.zh: 用户自定义的服务端点列表，默认创建一个VPC Endpoint
description.en: A list of custom server-side endpoints. By default, a VPC Endpoint is created.
The description of the server-side endpoint.
The type of the server-side endpoint. This value is fixed to Primary.
This parameter is required for knowledge applications.
This parameter is required for mem0 applications.

description.zh: 模型api，仅当 ApplicationType 为 polarclaw 时生效
description.en: The model API. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

description.zh: 模型API KEY，仅当 ApplicationType 为 polarclaw 时生效
description.en: The API key for the model. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

description.zh: 模型地址，仅当 ApplicationType 为 polarclaw 时生效
description.en: The URL of the model. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

description.zh:
模型来源，取值：
* bailian：百炼模型
* custom：自定义模型
* maas：PolarDB模型算子
description.en:
The source of the model. Valid values:

- bailian: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model.

- custom: A custom model.

- maas: PolarDB model operator.

description.zh: 模型名称，仅当 ApplicationType 为 polarclaw 时生效
description.en: The name of the model. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.
A list of parameters.
The name of the parameter.
The value of the parameter.
The billing method.
The subscription period type.

description.zh:
Polarlakebase 冷存版/高性能版实例ID，默认为空，若传入则将相应存储挂载到应用中

目前仅如下应用支持
- supabase
- raycluster
description.en:
The ID of the PolarFileSystem (PolarFS) cold storage or high-performance instance. This parameter is empty by default. If you specify this parameter, the corresponding storage is mounted to the application.

This feature is currently supported only by the following applications:

- supabase

- raycluster

description.zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
description.en: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used.
The region. The default value is the region of the instance.
The ID of the resource group.
The ID of the security group.

description.zh: IP白名单组的名称，默认为`default`
description.en: The name of the IP address whitelist group. The default value is `default`.

description.zh: IP白名单。如果不填写，则会默认为`127.0.0.1`。
description.en: The IP address whitelist. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value `127.0.0.1` is used.
The type of the IP address.
The ID of the skill template.
The tag.
The key of the tag.
The value of the tag.
The target version.
The subscription duration.

description.zh: 交换机，默认为实例主可用区当前的交换机
description.en: The vSwitch. The default value is the current vSwitch in the primary zone of the instance.
The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

description.zh: 可用区，默认为实例主可用区
description.en: The zone. The default value is the primary zone of the instance.
